# compact projective objects in solid modules　`cor.solid-compact-generators`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=cor.solid-compact-generators)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./cor.solid-compact-generators.md)

**(i)** The compact projective objects of $\mathbf{Solid}$ are exactly the groups of the form $\prod_I \mathbb{Z}$ ($I$ arbitrary).

**(ii)** $D(\mathbf{Solid})$ is generated by compact objects; the compact objects are bounded complexes whose terms are $\prod_I \mathbb{Z}$; the functor

$$D^b(\mathbb{Z})^{\mathrm{op}} \longrightarrow D(\mathbf{Solid})^\omega, \qquad C \longmapsto \operatorname{RHom}(C, \mathbb{Z})$$

is an equivalence of categories.

**(iii)** The derived solidification of $\mathbb{R}$ vanishes: $\mathbb{R}^{L\blacksquare} = 0$.
